chapter.ending: Use case: illustration-story. Landscape16:9 polished fantasy game ending CG, painterly anime illustration, no text or watermark. Rainy mountainous island at dusk after the storm has moved beyond the ridge. Warm amber lantern beneath an old slate-roof mountain shelter lights a reunion: elderly gray-haired lampkeeper in charcoal rain cloak raises the lamp as his young adult female apprentice in teal short rain cape and wrapped shins returns holding a copper measuring ruler. They look relieved, grounded emotions. A young teenage swordsman with messy dark-blue hair and royal-blue short cape stands a little behind them, quietly smiling. Far behind, a single gray stag with copper branching antlers walks ALIVE along the grassy ridge, no purple crystal remaining. Wet stone road, upright waymarker, shelter for two pack animals, restrained natural rain and beautiful glowing windows. Storm clouds moving toward distant peaks, grass remains rich and green. Cinematic composition, clear faces and hands, no dramatic sacrifice, no throne, no logos.
